desc.p: This method allows the cache owner to archive a geocache. Only the cache owner can delete a cache. When a cache is archived:

ul.li: The cache status changes to Archived
The cache listing remains visible (e.g. via direct URL or services/caches/geocache)
The cache is no longer active — new log entries cannot be submitted
All existing log entries remain in the system as historical records (they are NOT deleted)
Users can still view the listing and its history (read-only access)

desc.p: The term "Delete" here means: retire the cache from active play. The listing and its history are preserved; the cache is simply marked as archived and becomes read-only.

req.name: cache_code
req.p: Code of the cache to archive/delete. The authenticated user must be the cache owner.

opt.name: reason
opt.p: Optional reason for the deletion (for audit logging).

returns.p: A dictionary of the following structure:

li.p: success - true, if the cache was deleted successfully.
message - status message confirming the deletion and noting that logs remain.
